SPEC_TEXT: All mutating routes require secure session + CSRF, except OTAC request/verify.
All mutating routes require idempotency_key unless explicitly exempt.
All routes declare auth policy, RBAC owner, retry policy, audit emission, and error matrix.
AUTHORITY_CLASS: DOC-C BUILD SPEC / GLOBAL API LAW
EXPECTED_BEHAVIOR: Every final DOC-C canonical route is checked against the global response-envelope law.
Every mutating canonical route other than request-otac/verify-otac requires secure session and CSRF.
Every mutating canonical route requires idempotency_key unless final DOC-C explicitly exempts it.
Route verification covers auth, RBAC, retry, audit and error semantics rather than adapter existence only.
FORBIDDEN_BEHAVIOR: Do not infer an exemption that final DOC-C does not state.
Do not treat an HTTP adapter export as proof of route-law compliance.
Do not bypass secure session/CSRF/idempotency through helper or internal adapter paths that serve a canonical mutating route.
STATUS_REASON: Existing route-surface and envelope requirements cover parts of §4.1, but no dedicated denominator previously mapped all four global API laws across all twelve canonical routes.
